whatYouNeedToDo.emptyState: You don't need to do anything right now. If there's an update, we'll mail you a letter.

files.uploadDescription: You can submit documents while we review your application. But this may delay our decision.

files.ohiDescription: If you need to update your other non-VA health insurance information, you'll need to submit a separate form (VA Form 10-7959c).
